summary: Man and his dog summited Quandary Peak and got into trouble descending the East Ridge as storms built; legs cramping badly and water low; wife called for help from out of state, then he called himself; ground team turned back near treeline due to weather; helicopter flew man and dog to the trailhead; he refused medical treatment, neither was hurt
responding_agency: Summit County Rescue Group, Summit County Sheriff's Office, Flight for Life
notes: Victim: 1 man plus 1 dog, both uninjured; described alongside a second Quandary rescue four days later in the same TNS article
